title: 具体 UI 清单由源项目拥有，Foundry 只做跨项目规范化索引
summary: 数百个具体界面、工具、面板、对话框和工作区不应被强行提升为数百条 Grammar Pattern。产品仓库通过 .uigs/ui-surfaces.json 持有具体 UI 清单；Foundry 按稳定 Surface ID 收集实现位置、实际效果、Pattern 关系、测试和视觉证据，形成派生索引。
principles: The product repository is authoritative for concrete UI surface existence and implementation location.
Foundry owns the cross-project index, schemas and reusable Pattern semantics, not duplicate product source.
Concrete Surface IDs remain stable across presentation refactors when product identity is stable.
A concrete Surface may map to zero, one or multiple reusable Patterns.
Implementation effect, source references, tests and visual evidence are separate fields.
Missing production visual evidence is explicit and must not be filled with Foundry reference-demo images.
Missing project inventory is reported as coverage debt rather than invented from guesswork.
A declared zero-surface inventory is coverage-complete for a service with no built-in UI and is distinct from a missing inventory.
